title: 将幻觉视为特性而非缺陷：评估一种将推测性语言模型输出转化为可测试科学假设的多智能体架构
summary: 本文提出一种基于Rust的多智能体编排系统，利用高熵生成智能体与网络接地评估智能体之间的认知摩擦循环，通过低熵语义瓶颈减少噪声，将LLM的幻觉转化为可测试的科学假设。实验表明，直接提示效果最弱，完整系统在强约束下优势明显，但并非普遍优于简单自反思。
summary_en: This paper proposes a Rust-based multi-agent orchestration that leverages an epistemological friction loop between a high-entropy generator and a web-grounded evaluator, mediated by a low-entropy semantic bottleneck, to transform LLM hallucinations into testable scientific hypotheses. Experiments show direct prompting is weakest, and the full system excels under strong constraints but not universally over self-reflection.
